decisions.reason: A consumer vegan drink mix is far from the firm's waste-to-energy competence, and with only a passing mention and no evidence of results, it likely falls short of aspirations, so a small firm with limited slack would redirect its resources to its core plant business.
Modular extensions build on the existing waste-to-energy offering and cost little to keep listed, so management can keep them despite uncertain results.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own web page, which signals it is a core product the firm is committed to and that it likely meets aspirations.

The plastic-to-fuel plant fits the firm's energy-from-waste competence and a growing market, so it is worth keeping, although its brief mention suggests early-stage uncertainty that could prompt search for other uses of resources if results lag.
